# Lalit Enterprises — Full Reference

## Company

Lalit Enterprises has operated as an authorised Xuping Jewellery wholesale agent out of Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India since 2002, supplying everyday-wear imitation jewellery to resellers, boutique owners, and retailers across India. The business is built on consistency for repeat wholesale buyers: the same quality, fair pricing, and stock reliability on every reorder, plus direct WhatsApp access to a real person and 1-on-1 video call consultations so buyers can see the actual finish, colour, and weight of a piece before ordering. The catalogue carries 1,000+ designs and is restocked with new Xuping styles monthly, serving resellers in 35+ cities across India.

Registered address: 39/2 EK, Agraharam St, Edapalaiyam, Park Town, Chennai, Greater Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600003, India.

## Who This Is For

This is a wholesale/B2B site, not a retail storefront. The intended audience is resellers, boutique owners, and retailers across India buying in bulk for resale — not individual consumers buying one piece at a time.

## What We Sell

Xuping-brand imitation (fashion/costume) jewellery: anti-tarnish, gold-plated, non-allergic, everyday-wear designs. Products are reference designs — Xuping jewellery contains no precious metals or gemstones unless explicitly stated, and actual stock, finish, and availability are confirmed at order time, including via video call.

## Ordering, Pricing & Wholesale Terms

- **Minimum order quantity (MOQ):** 6 pieces per design for Bali, Stud, and Ring collections; 2 pieces per design for all other collections.
- **Minimum order value (MOV):** Rs 20,000 per order, across designs.
- **Pricing:** Genuine wholesale rates, no retail markup, no middlemen. Prices are not published online and are confirmed per order (bulk/wholesale pricing varies by quantity and design) — contact via WhatsApp, the enquiry form, or a video call to get current pricing.
- **How to order:** Via WhatsApp, a free 1-on-1 video call consultation, or the enquiry/appointment forms on this website.
- **Payment:** UPI, bank transfer, or WhatsApp Pay, as communicated at the time an order is finalised. Orders are dispatched only after payment is confirmed.

## Shipping / Dispatch

Confirmed and paid orders are dispatched from Chennai within 24–48 hours. Delivery timelines thereafter depend on the courier partner and the buyer's location within India (pan-India delivery). Lalit Enterprises is not responsible for delays caused by courier services once an order has been dispatched.
